nodes.description: IERC20 token contract held by the timelock (private state variable in TokenTimelock).
Address of the beneficiary allowed to extract tokens after release (private state variable).
Timestamp after which the held tokens may be released (private state variable).
TokenTimelock constructor; validates releaseTime against block.timestamp and initializes _token, _beneficiary and _releaseTime.
View getter returning the held token contract _token.
View getter returning the beneficiary address _beneficiary.
View getter returning the release timestamp _releaseTime.
Virtual function that checks block.timestamp against _releaseTime and transfers the whole token balance to the beneficiary.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp used in the constructor sanity check and in the release time gate.
External token transfer _token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) performed before any state finalization, the reentrancy-prone value transfer in release().
CATXTimeLock constructor that forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
IERC20 token parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
address beneficiary parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
uint256 releaseTime parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
address token parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, cast to IERC20 and forwarded to the base constructor.
address beneficiary parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, forwarded to the base constructor.
uint256 releaseTime parameter of the CATXTimeLock constructor, forwarded to the base constructor.
Local variable holding the full token balance of the timelock, passed to the external transfer.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is assigned to the _releaseTime state variable.
releaseTime parameter is consumed by the constructor logic that validates and stores it.
Constructor require(releaseTime > block.timestamp) branches on the untrusted block timestamp.
release() gate require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime) depends on the miner-influenceable block timestamp.
The stored _releaseTime controls whether release() execution proceeds.
The stored _token state variable is the target of the external safeTransfer call.
The stored _beneficiary state variable is the recipient of the external token transfer.
Local amount (queried token balance) is the value forwarded to the external transfer.
release() unconditionally executes the external value transfer after its checks.
The external ERC20 call hands control to an outside contract that could re-enter release() before state is finalized.
token() reads and returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() reads and returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() reads and returns the _releaseTime state variable.
